title: Bayesian Empirical Bayes: Simultaneous Inference from Probabilistic Symmetries
abstract: arXiv:2512.16239v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Empirical Bayes (EB) improves the accuracy of simultaneous inference "by learning from the experience of others" (Efron, 2012). Classical EB theory focuses on latent variables that are iid draws from a fitted prior (Efron, 2019). Modern applications, however, feature complex structure, like arrays, spatial processes, or covariates. We propose a generalized approach to empirical Bayes based on probabilistic symmetry. Our method pairs a simultaneous inference problem with an unknown prior to a symmetry assumption on the joint distribution of the latent variables. Each symmetry implies an ergodic decomposition, which we use to derive a corresponding empirical Bayes method. We call this method Bayesian empirical Bayes (BEB). BEB recovers classical empirical Bayes methods, which implicitly assume exchangeability. We extend EB to other probabilistic symmetries: (i) EB matrix recovery for arrays and graphs; (ii) covariate-informed EB

translated_title: 贝叶斯经验贝叶斯：基于概率对称性的同时推断
translated_abstract: arXiv:2512.16239v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：经验贝叶斯（EB）通过“从他人经验中学习”来提高同时推断的准确性（Efron, 2012）。经典EB理论侧重于从拟合先验中独立同分布抽取的潜变量（Efron, 2019）。然而，现代应用涉及复杂结构，如数组、空间过程或协变量。我们提出了一种基于概率对称性的广义经验贝叶斯方法。我们的方法将具有未知先验的同时推断问题与潜变量联合分布的对称性假设配对。每个对称性都隐含一个遍历分解，我们利用它来推导相应的经验贝叶斯方法。我们将此方法称为贝叶斯经验贝叶斯（BEB）。BEB恢复了经典经验贝叶斯方法，这些方法隐含地假设可交换性。我们将EB扩展到其他概率对称性：（i）数组和图矩阵恢复的EB；（ii）协变量信息化的EB。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于概率对称性的广义经验贝叶斯方法（BEB），通过遍历分解将经典EB扩展到数组、图等复杂结构，并恢复了可交换性假设下的经典结果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a generalized empirical Bayes method (BEB) based on probabilistic symmetry, using ergodic decompositions to extend EB to complex structures like arrays and graphs while recovering classical exchangeability-based results.
